title: dartrics analysis report (JSON reporter)
description: Schema for the JSON output of `dartrics analyze --reporter json`. Mirrors the in-memory `AnalysisReport` shape; field names are stable through the 0.x series, additions are non-breaking, renames trigger a major bump.

version.description: Reporter schema version. Bumped to `1.1` in 0.7.0 to cover `explanations` and `staleDismissals`; to `1.2` for `ScopeRef.endLine` — all non-breaking additions.

analyzedFiles.description: Per-file fingerprints used to drive snapshot-mode diffs. Only emitted by the JSON reporter; the markdown / ai / sarif / console reporters omit it because the snapshot file is the source of truth.

snapshotMode.description: Snapshot mode active for this run. Distinguishes a `0`-violations report from a `0`-violations-after-cache-filter report.

changedFileCount.description: Number of files that survived the diff filter (cache snapshot or `--since`). Absent when no diff filter is active — the report covers every analyzed file.

explanations.description: Rationale + refactor hints + references for each metric that fired at least one violation. Mirrors the AI and Markdown reporters' explanation blocks; previously absent from JSON output, restored so machine consumers see the same context.

staleDismissals.description: Dismissal entries (YAML or comment) that never matched a live violation in this run. Surfaced so AI loops and reviewers can prune dead entries before they accumulate. Only emitted when at least one stale entry was detected.

signals.description: Per-declaration call-graph reference signals (fan-in / fan-out). Carries no threshold and no severity — surfaced as reference information for the AI loop to compare against intent, not as a verdict to act on.

endLine.description: Last line of the scope's declaration, inclusive. Populated on fresh analysis; `--since` intersects this span with the diff's hunk ranges so untouched scopes in a changed file stay out of the report. Absent on reports written before 1.2.

values.description: Map of metric id → numeric value computed for this scope.

id.description: Stable 16-hex-char identifier for the (file, scope, metric) triple. Survives line-number drift; AI loops use it to correlate violations across runs.

level.description: Severity at which the threshold was crossed.

threshold.description: Threshold value the scope's metric reached or exceeded.

scopeCoverage.description: Line coverage for this scope, in [0.0, 1.0]. Only present when --coverage is engaged.

scopeBranchCoverage.description: Branch coverage for this scope, in [0.0, 1.0]. Only present when BRDA records exist.

complexityJustified.description: True when CC / Cognitive crossed threshold but coverage is high enough that the complexity is most likely earned. Only emitted when set.

complexityJustifiedBy.description: Which coverage rule fired: `branch` when branch coverage data was available and crossed its threshold, or `line` when branch data was missing and line coverage was used as the more conservative fallback. Only emitted when `complexityJustified: true`.

complexityJustifiedThreshold.description: The literal threshold the rule named in `complexityJustifiedBy` had to cross. Currently 0.8 for `branch` and 0.95 for `line`. Surfaces the engine's decision so consumers don't have to look it up. Only emitted when `complexityJustified: true`.

dismissed.description: True when a `dartrics:dismiss` directive (comment or YAML) matched this violation and passed validation. Only emitted when set.

dismissedFrom.description: Channel the accepted dismissal came from. Only emitted when `dismissed: true`.

dismissReason.description: Reason text carried in from the matched dismissal.

dismissedBy.description: Author tag from a YAML dismissal's `by:` field. YAML-only.

dismissedAt.description: Timestamp from a YAML dismissal's `at:` field, serialised as ISO-8601. YAML-only.

dismissalRejected.description: Set when a dismissal entry matched the violation but failed validation (e.g. reason too short). Mutually exclusive with `dismissed`.

metric.description: Metric id this rationale block describes.

rationale.description: Free-form prose explaining why the metric exists and what it tries to surface.

refactorHints.description: Bulleted action hints for bringing a violating scope back under threshold.

references.description: Citations the metric is anchored to (papers, books, established standards). Only emitted when the calculator declares one.

file.description: Project-relative path of the file declaring the scope.

fanInCallers.description: Distinct project-local declarations that reference this scope. Renaming-blast-radius proxy.

fanInCalls.description: Total invocation-edge count pointing at this scope. `foo()` mentioned three times in `A` contributes 3 here.

fanOutCallees.description: Distinct project-local declarations this scope references.

fanOutCalls.description: Total invocation-edge count originating from this scope.

file.description: Project-relative path of the file the dismissal targeted.

source.description: Which channel the dismissal came from. AI loops use this to know whether the cleanup edit is in source or in the YAML file.

reason.description: Original `reason:` text from the dismissal, kept so the cleanup decision stays informed. Absent when the dismissal had no reason.
